1.w: A Song. A Psalm of David. My heart being firm, O God, I will sing and make music, even with my glory!

2.w: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn!

3.w: I will praise You among the peoples, O YHWH, and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

4.w: For great over the heavens [is] Your loving devotion, and up to the clouds [is] Your faithfulness.

5.w: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and over all the earth Your glory!

6.w: That Your beloved may be delivered, save [with] Your right hand, and answer me!

7.w: God has spoken from His holy place: “I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.

8.w: Unto Me [is] Gilead, unto Me [is] Manasseh; and Ephraim [is] the strength of My head, Judah [is] My scepter.

9.w: Moab [is] the basin of My washing; upon Edom I will cast My sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”

10.w: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?

11.w: Have You not, O God, cast us off? And will You no longer go forth, O God, with our armies?

12.w: May You give to us help from adversity, and the salvation of man [is] emptiness.

13.w: With God we will act [in] strength, and He will trample our adversaries.
